blocks.text: Kingdom Animalia ko mote taur par neeche diye gaye phyla mein baanta jata hai. Har phylum mein in baaton par dhyan dein: symmetry (jism ka tawazun), embryo ki kitni tissue layers, body cavity (jism ki khaali jagah), digestive (hazme ka), circulatory (khoon chalane ka), excretory (fuzla nikalne ka) aur nervous system, aur reproduction. Exam mein aksar inhi ka muqabla (comparison) poochha jata hai.

blocks.title: Woh alfaaz jo har phylum mein aate hain
blocks.text: Diploblastic: jism embryo ki do layers, ectoderm aur endoderm, se banta hai. Triploblastic: teen layers, jin ke darmiyan mesoderm hota hai. Acoelomate: body cavity nahi hoti. Pseudocoelomate: jhooti (false) body cavity, jo poori tarah mesoderm se ghiri nahi hoti. Coelomate: asal coelom, jo chaaron taraf se mesoderm se ghira hota hai. Protostome aur deuterostome coelomates ke do groups hain; farq is baat ka hai ke embryo mein mouth kaise banta hai.

blocks.alt: Keere jaise jism ke teen cross-sections. Acoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan ki jagah tissue se bhari hai. Pseudocoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan fluid se bhari cavity hai, jis par mesoderm sirf bahar ki taraf hai. Coelomate: cavity dono taraf se mesoderm se ghiri hai aur gut us mein latka hua hai.
blocks.caption: Acoelomate, pseudocoelomate aur coelomate body plans (asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har section mein bahar wala halqa body wall hai aur andar wala halqa gut. Flatworms acoelomate hain: parenchyma jagah bharta hai. Roundworms pseudocoelomate hain: cavity fluid se bhari hai lekin gut ko seedha chhooti hai. Molluscs, annelids, arthropods, echinoderms aur chordates coelomate hain: mesoderm body wall aur gut dono par hota hai.
